Most people think AI is just a writing tool. That's exactly why they never make a dollar with it. The real shift isn't that AI writes faster, it's that the entire economics of building and selling a digital product quietly collapsed, and almost nobody has adjusted to what that actually means yet. In this video I walk through the full 30-day process I used, where the leverage actually lives, and the part most people get wrong before they even start.
